title: Moto Kare no Neko wo, Azukarimashite.

overview: The TLDR News is here to guide you through the chaos of Donald Trump's second administration while highlighting What to Follow.
title: What to Follow: USA

overview: The story of a Kazakh family who moved from their village to a big city but haven't yet found their own place to live and are forced to share a rented apartment. Bakytzhan and his family moved from their native village to the big city several years ago. Here he works as a taxi driver, and although city life is no stranger to him, he hasn't yet managed to shed his provincial habits.
title: Квартиранттар

overview: Isolation and desolate stretches create the perfect hunting ground. Uncover the shocking, untold mysteries behind the nation's bloodiest roads in this gritty true crime series.
title: Outback Murder Highway

overview: Explore pivotal moments defining our nation. From Black Saturday to the Lindt Cafe, expert voices and rare footage reveal the events that forever reshaped modern Australia.
title: Events That Changed Australia

overview: Meet Zack and Cody, 11 year-old identical twins and the newest residents of Boston's swanky Tipton Hotel on The Suite Life of Zack and Cody.
title: The Suite Life of Zack and Cody

overview: Docudrama following events at Dunkirk in May and June 1940.
title: Dunkirk

overview: The most insane and eccentric modern rulers, dictators, and kings of the modern era.
title: Mad Kings

overview: Kang Yong Ho is the chairman of the Choiseong Group, a leading conglomerate in South Korea. He built the company by himself, and he is now known as the "God of Business". One day, he has an unexpected accident. He collides with a young man named Hwang Jun Hyeon. Hwang Jun Hyeon is a soccer player who has just joined the League 1 team FC Choiseong. Due to the accident, Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul is swapped with soccer player Hwang Jun Hyeon's soul. With Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul in Hwang Jun Hyeon's body, he applies to the Choiseong Group as a new employee. He begins his unpredictable journey with his soul as an outstanding businessman and the young body of Hwang Jun Hyeon.
title: Reborn Rookie

overview: Celebrity moms will show host Ivan Pyshnenko their homes, introduce him to their families, and share their experiences, achievements, and happy moments. Participants include blogger, innovative mother, and singer Sasha Zvereva; top model, TV presenter, and advocate of traditional parenting views Elena Kuletskaya; and others.
title: Мама LIFE

overview: A social drama about infogypsies, business coaches, and startup founders, brand worship, social media addiction, and the modern realities of friendships made for money and family relationships. The series' protagonist, Sergei, and his friend go to a junkyard every weekend to collect scrap metal. At least, that's what he tells his wife and father...
title: Наставник

overview: Let The Conversation begin... Lifetime's all-new series The Conversation with Amanda de Cadenet (aka "The Conversation"), is a refreshing and intimate take on celebrity interviews hosted by British television personality and renowned photographer Amanda de Cadenet and executive produced by Demi Moore and de Cadenet, will premiere on Thursday, April 26, at 11:00pm ET/PT. The hour-long program created by de Cadenet marks her U.S. television debut. Presenting an honest, authentic and raw view of the shared issues affecting women today, each episode of The Conversation with Amanda de Cadenet will feature de Cadenet having powerful and in-depth interviews with some of the world's most famous and influential women, including, among others, Jane Fonda, Lady Gaga, Gwyneth Paltrow, Miley Cyrus, Eva Longoria, Kelly Preston, Alicia Keys, New York Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, Donna Karan, Ivanka Trump, Olivia Wilde and Gabby Sidibe. Together with de Cadenet in the comfort of her or their own homes, they -- many for the first time publicly -- will tackle a wide variety of topics universal to all females, including sexuality, body image, career and finances, relationships, love and loss, politics, human rights, transformation, breakthrough and perseverance. The Conversation with Amanda de Cadenet will also feature "Women on the Street" segments in which women from all walks of life also reveal their personal feelings about their lives and the world today.
title: The Conversation with Amanda de Cadenet

overview: Who said you have to retire at 60? This show is quite the opposite. Seasoned business executives, familiar with the intricacies of business firsthand, rush to the aid of their younger, less experienced, yet creative colleagues. Young businessmen who started their own businesses and found themselves at the bottom, young scientists struggling to complete a research project, any young professionals who started their careers and found themselves at a dead end—they all need the support and experience of our show's heroes.
title: Наставник

overview: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers, a heart-pounding ride into nature at its most extreme. The series follows twelve teams of certified weather spotters and professional storm chasers as they self-shoot their close encounters with dangerous tornadoes. With no producers or camera crews, each team ventures into America's Tornado Alley, risking everything to spot tornados, warn people in harm's way, and help save lives when disaster strikes. The series captures raw, harrowing encounters as storm chasers, outfitted with their own camera rigs and advanced weather tech, race into the American Midwest during one of the most active tornado seasons in decades. These men and women risk their lives while redefining storm chasing for a new generation.
title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers

overview: Farming for Love will follow a group of single farmers as they search for lasting love. Set against the backdrop of rural Britain, the series sees farmers invite potential partners to live and work alongside them, offering an authentic look at both modern relationships and the realities of British farming life. The series will follow a group of farmers from across the UK, each ready to open up their farms and their lives in the hope of finding a lasting connection. Guiding them through this journey will be Lisa Hogan, as she brings her experience of farming, her humour and straight-talking honesty to the role.
title: Farming for Love

overview: Cardo Dalisay is a dedicated police officer with an unshakable commitment to save lives and fight for the common good despite having to face many enemies who are determined to destroy him.
title: Ang Probinsyano

overview: Set in a leafy London suburb, The Only Suspect follows Alex and Beth, a devoted couple whose picture-perfect suburban life hides a devastating truth. Moving between the present day and mid-90s Camden - at the height of Cool Britannia - the story opens during the sweltering summer of 1995, when a young man buries a body during a violent storm. Who the victim is, and why they were killed, is a mystery that tantalisingly threads through the narrative as past and present collide.
title: The Only Suspect

overview: Major Zherekhov is an experienced operative and the head of the police department in Murom. He has a wife and a 10-year-old daughter: his wife dreams of moving to Moscow, but Zherekhov is against it. On this basis, conflicts often arise in the family: if it were not for the daughter, they would have divorced a long time ago. In addition, he has a secret affair with Investigator Ivolgina. It is she who, in her spare time, investigates a case that, according to Zherekhov, does not exist. Ivolgina is convinced that the five girls who disappeared in different areas of the Vladimir region are victims of a serial killer: all, plus or minus, of the same age and build. She insists that a case should be opened, but Zherekhov is categorically against it – there are no bodies or evidence. But Ivolgina does not back down and continues to pursue this case, which she calls the "Invisible Man's case" in private. Only after a series of events in the service and in his personal life and the death of a loved one, Zherekhov realizes that the Ivolgina case is the real thing, and a serial killer is operating in the region.
title: Ночной

overview: Alexey Shuvalov, nicknamed Magaban, is one of the most daring and charismatic bandits of the 90s era, but too humane for the criminal world. Left out of work and penniless, Shuvalov gets tired of being a simple bath attendant. The security post in this bathhouse is occupied by Igor Rubtsov, nicknamed Bruce, in the past one of the most famous, cool and scandalous operas, who kept the whole city in fear, but did not accept the new rules of the system.
title: Псы и волки

overview: This ITV drama focuses on the Grand Hotel in Manchester post World War One. It examines the lives of the Bannisters as they struggle to restore the hotel to its former glory and the servants below stairs who struggle with their day to day lives in a class ridden, hypocritical society. Actress Julia St. John (The Brittas Empire) plays Sarah Bannerman, the angst ridden manageress, Tim Healy (Auf Wiedersehen,Pet) is Mr Collins, the diplomatic doorman and Mark McGann is the manipulative, amoral Marcus Bannerman. Veteran actress Susan Hampshire gives a superb performance as Esme Harkness, the ageing Madame, in this classic costume drama that aired for two series between 1997 and 1998.
title: The Grand

overview: Retired military man and former special forces soldier Sergei Dedov, nicknamed "Ded," returns to his native Moscow to be with his daughter Anna and granddaughter Katya. But he finds himself without a place in the lives of those closest to him. And then one day, despite her mother and grandfather's misgivings, Katya decided to spend the holidays in St. Petersburg with a friend. The girls left, and soon afterward, an alarming call came: his granddaughter, haltingly, reported that she was about to be kidnapped. Without telling his daughter, Dedov left for St. Petersburg. Accused of devoting little time to his family and spending his life protecting anyone but his family, Sergei is now determined to prove otherwise. Despite his retirement, the former military man will again and again recall his combat experience and help those who desperately need his support and have almost given up hope.
title: Отставник

overview: The protagonist is retired Lieutenant Colonel Yuri Zhukovsky, who lives a lonely bachelor life. His monotony is unexpectedly shattered when Zhukovsky meets his former superior, General Terentyev. He sends the former special forces commander on a trip to a military unit in the regional city of Zarechensk. There, he must establish the cause of a tragedy—the escape and death of a private soldier. The former colonel goes against the advice of his command and the commission, launching his own investigation into the criminal enterprise. With the help of his fiancée, Zhukovsky uncovers the true motives behind the soldier's escape by discovering a hidden phone.
title: Отставник. Позывной «бродяга»

overview: Colonel Dedov has long since retired from the military, finding his calling in the military-patriotic education of youth. But one day, an assassination attempt is made on him: an unknown assailant breaks into his apartment, and only thanks to his military acumen and self-defense skills does Dedov escape death. His situation is further complicated by the fact that he kills the assassin in the fight against the assailant. Dedov ends up behind bars. Who could the old retiree have interfered with? Is there a connection between the assassination attempt and the death of his old comrade, Yegorov? And what really happened during the military operation in Angola in 2002? To find the answers to these questions, Dedov must escape from prison.
title: Отставник. Один за всех

overview: Colonel Dedov has been imprisoned and is serving a sentence for the murder of a hitman. A top-secret research leak has been discovered at a research institute, and the institution's head of security, retired Colonel Grigoriev, suddenly disappears. They're counting on Dedov, who, as a member of the famous "old school," is capable of finding the traitor before he flees abroad. The retired colonel is only too happy to be able to leave prison for a while, so he takes on the task...
title: Отставник. Спасти врага

overview: In the 2000s, Janelle was a popular soloist of the infamous duet "Sladkaya Vata". After leaving the stage, she started a charity foundation with the support of Arman Ospanov. However, her life changed dramatically when Arman was arrested for corruption. The relationship between Arman and Janelle only worsened the situation. Janelle lost everything and moved to her sister's house. Everyone looked down on Janelle. In order to regain her honor and find out the truth, she returned to music. Who organized this ordeal for her?
title: Жаңа Жанель

overview: Horse racing and love triangles go hand in hand at Raintree Ranch. Will Kris get the fresh start she desperately needs?
title: Wildfire

overview: Join our star-studded cast as we look back at some of the greatest Reality TV moments. Shock eliminations, explosive drama and iconic one-liners. Celebrate the chaos that got the country talking.
title: The Greatest

overview: In the world of crime and justice, dangerous missions force those on opposite sides of the law to choose between protecting family and doing their duty.
title: Blood vs Duty

overview: Money is a five-part series about power dynamics, trust, loyalty - and money. Tom Scott hosts five well-known internet personalities, playing games based on economics experiments to win $10,000. But can they work together to win it? Or will they only think of themselves?
title: Tom Scott Presents: Money

overview: Monthly updates of the major news and developments from ongoing wars and conflicts from around the world.
title: War Room

overview: 4x20: Quick Hits is a new anthology series highlighting cannabis and the people who love it. Made up of four, twenty-minute films, each by a dope director in celebration of what is arguably the world's most beloved plant.
title: 4x20: Quick Hits

overview: Anderson Cooper reports on the latest developments in the War with Iran.
title: CNN Global Report: War with Iran

overview: Upon moving to Rio for a new project, Gabriela reunites with Anna, an old childhood acquaintance. The reunion awakens feelings that both had been trying to forget. Meanwhile, Pedro is experiencing an intense romance with photographer Luiz, who soon begins to feel used and turns to his friend Nala for support. Amidst unresolved memories and desires, everyone must grapple with choices that could change the course of their stories.
title: Pra Onde Gira O Sol

overview: Nostalgia is a powerful thing that few people can resist. The memory of carefree youthful days haunts both gray-haired elders and people who have just crossed the threshold of thirty, the so-called millennials. This show is aimed at them – young, active, accomplished, and fondly reminiscing about their childhood and youth. At the beginning of each episode, a specific theme is announced, and the guests of the program begin to "dance" around it. They reminisce about their school days, laugh and blush about their first dates, and share other nostalgic moments from their lives.
title: БЫЛО ТАКОЕ

overview: Ralf Schumacher says "I do": to his longtime partner Étienne Bousquet Cassagne, to a new chapter in his life, and to sharing his story openly on Sky. The four-part Sky Original documentary "Ralf & Étienne: We Say Yes" follows the couple on their journey to their wedding in Saint-Tropez, showing Ralf Schumacher and his partner more personally and intimately than ever before.
title: Ralf & Étienne: Wir sagen Ja

overview: Akara, who has been hurt repeatedly in love, finds it hard to believe that he will ever meet true love in this lifetime. One day, he makes a wish at a temple, telling himself to "try one last time." At that very moment, he meets Intha, a rugged and confident bar owner. Intha trusts his instincts and begins pursuing Akara openly, but Akara, scarred by past pain, cannot bring himself to accept his feelings. As the two work and live together at Cherm Chey bar, with alcohol loosening their hearts and everyday care drawing them closer, they gradually go from strangers to becoming the person each wants to protect most.
title: Cherm Chey

overview: Saithan is forced to leave home, embarking on a journey to prove himself. With his dreams and burdens in tow, he heads to Chiang Rai, hoping for a fresh start. By chance, he meets Sila, a man who becomes his pillar during a time of deep physical and emotional pain. In Sila's presence, Saithan begins to heal, slowly learning not only how to love but also how to allow himself to be loved. As their bond deepens, Saithan discovers the true Sila - beneath the stoic exterior is a gentle soul, wounded by betrayal from those he trusted. In a twist of fate, Saithan becomes Sila's protector. No longer waiting for someone to rescue him, he realizes he has the strength to care for those he loves.
title: Your Dear Daddy

overview: When Ben Reith is woken in his London home to be told that his wife Claire has gone missing, it's the start of a global news story, because Claire is an astronaut crewing the UK's first moonbase and she's disappeared into the long lunar night… Claire is the first woman to set foot on the moon. A biologist taking part in a groundbreaking research project, her disappearance throws suspicion on her fellow astronauts and China's rival base. With hundreds of thousands of miles between them, can Ben uncover the truth behind his wife's disappearance?
title: First Woman
Umanai Onna wa Dame desu ka? DINKs no Totsukitooka
Chun Hen Fu Qi Bu Shuo Ai

overview: The show centered on a group of young vampires subjected to a daring experiment by the "Elders": taken in by a boarding school that also housed mortal teenagers, with the intent of civilizing the vampires. Many problems faced the students on both the day and night curriculum, including typical teen issues of love, friends and enemies. Dr. Murdoch was on hand to help them along with their school work, but he too had problems that could put the lives of the teens in mortal danger.
title: Vampire High
Zhi Gei Qian Bu Hui Jia De Lao Gong Tu Ran Hui Lai Le

overview: Xie Qingyuan, orphaned at a young age, lived on the streets until she met Shen Run, who had been sent to the army after a family tragedy. They parted ways with a promise to survive, and Shen Run gave her a penny as a token. Years later, Xie Qingyuan returns to Xie Mansion, determined to uncover the truth about her mother's death. As Shen Run rises to power, he is assigned to oversee the Xie family during a crisis. While working together, the two rekindle their bond. Shen Run is drawn to Xie Qingyuan's courage, intelligence, and optimism, while she grows to trust him as a close ally and friend.
title: Spring of the Blade

overview: Sun Jingcheng and Zhou Yu agree to divorce, believing they can quietly end their marriage. But everything changes when they are entrusted with their niece, whose existence has been kept secret from the family. Forced to pretend they are still happily married, they navigate family chaos, hidden truths, and unexpected challenges. As old feelings resurface, will they find their way back to each other?
title: Be With Me

overview: Vintage pop, rock and soul performances from the BBC archives.
title: Sounds of the Seventies

overview: Archive footage of rock, pop and soul performances from the 1980s.
title: Sounds of the Eighties

overview: Sila, a sharp and meticulous young CEO suffering from severe burnout and chronic insomnia, decides to go undercover to inspect his property, Zantiis Ndol Villas. Using the alias "Kin," he hopes to find some rest while secretly evaluating his staff. However, chaos ensues during the High Season when a system glitch causes his reserved room to be double-booked. Tonnam, a dedicated receptionist who lives by the motto "The Guest is God," refuses to turn the other guests away. Seeing how exhausted "Kin" looks, Tonnam offers his own accommodation—a wooden staff house by the stream—as a temporary solution, but on one condition: they must share the room. Amidst the cozy space, the soothing sounds of Muak Lek Waterfall, and Tonnam's cheerful energy, the once-cold and sleepless Sila discovers that this simple life is the perfect cure for his insomnia. He soon finds himself addicted to his new life as "Kin"—and to being the roommate of this charming receptionist.
title: Zantiis

overview: Barbara has an equation for everything: grades, friendships, choices, the future. If mathematics explains the universe, why couldn't it explain happiness? But there's one variable she hasn't yet been able to calculate: herself. Between the faith she inherited, the expectations she carries, and the life she wants to build, Barbara will discover that some answers don't fit into any formula.
title: Calculando o Amor

overview: Over 2,660 applicants are entering the new Miss Germany season with their own mission. A mammoth task lies ahead for the team and jury: Who will impress in the preliminary selection with their inspiration, development potential, and professionalism? In which candidate will the team recognize the potential for the next Miss Germany?
title: Road to Miss Germany Presented by Cupra

overview: After being betrayed and killed, a prince is reincarnated three years in the past, but upon reuniting with his former best friend, he discovers that perhaps his friend was never really his enemy.
title: Journey with you

overview: Close Protection is about an American bodyguard protecting a British princess.
title: Close Protection

overview: The Nanny Diaries centers on Annie, a broke, aspiring writer in search of a story who takes a nanny job for a magnetic Upper East Side socialite, plunging into an elite world of unimaginable excess. When she lands the book deal of her dreams to go undercover and expose the salacious lives of the ultra-rich, Annie must try to keep up this double life even as she grows attached to the people and this world… and finds out what her elusive boss is actually capable of.
title: The Nanny Diaries

overview: The Belonging explores identity, heritage, and the meaning of belonging in top-level international football. It focuses on players with dual nationality – including Manuel Akanji, Breel Embolo, Ivan Rakitić, and Albian Hajdari – who speak openly about personal decisions that extend far beyond the realm of sport.
title: The Belonging

overview: Record Breakers is a British children's TV show, themed around world records and produced by the BBC. It was broadcast on BBC1 from 15 December 1972 to 21 December 2001. It was originally presented by Roy Castle with Guinness World Records founders twin brothers Norris McWhirter and Ross McWhirter.
title: Record Breakers

overview: A mutual redemption between a top star and his muse. That unexpected kiss that year was also a fateful encounter.
title: Private Galaxy
YIRU: A Sword and Fairy Story

overview: Busman's Holiday is a British television game show produced by Granada for the ITV network from 26 February 1985 to 28 June 1993. Contestants were divided into competing teams of three based upon career, at first three teams and later in the series just two teams. They were dressed in their regular work clothes. The winning team went on an exotic holiday where they had to work, to learn how their jobs were performed in other locations.
title: Busman's Holiday

overview: Reuniting once again, Jinny's Kitchen team members Jung Yu-mi, Park Seo-jun, and Choi Woo-shik set off on a trip not to work, but to truly unwind. Set against scenic destinations across Korea, this reality show captures their genuine friendship, unexpected moments, and the carefree spirit of youth at its most natural.
title: Unplanned Trip: Limited Edition

overview: After experiencing deep pain, betrayal, and heartbreak, Fernanda decides to turn her back on everything related to faith. However, an unexpected agreement changes the course of her life: five nights, five conversations, and five chances to prove that God exists.
title: A menina que morava no colegio

overview: Darnell aspires to be an astronaut, but his rough neighborhood presents unforeseen challenges. Confronting hardship, friendship, and survival, his destiny remains uncertain. Can he overcome his environment or will it consume him?
title: Mama I'm A Thot

overview: When 'Pawida' (Honey), a leading model known as the 'Princess on the Catwalk' has to clash with 'Alin' a top-tier actress dubbed the 'Angel of the Industry.' Their once-beautiful friendship falls apart because of rumors and misunderstandings, turning them into a 'sworn enemy pair' who can no longer work together. Everything changes when 'Pawida' accidentally discovers 'Alin's' secret— a secret that the other party never intended for anyone to know. Just like 'Pawida' herself, who has a past that should never be exposed. Paths in life that were never meant to cross are inexplicably pulled together. If both of them are like the moon in the night sky, no one knows what is hidden beneath that glowing light. And who knows... how the story of this actress and model duo will ultimately end?
title: Lunar Secret

overview: Chris, a young woman suffering from amnesia, is recovering and living with her loving partner, Nadia, after an accident four years ago. Everything seems to be going well, but then the arrival of a strange woman named Sun begins to shake Chris's beliefs.
title: Third Person

overview: After being diagnosed with end-stage liver disease at the age of 28, Made in Chelsea's Sam Vanderpump navigates his journey towards a life-saving liver transplant while also becoming a husband and dad.
title: Made in Chelsea: Sam Vanderpump's Story

overview: Salisbury Poisonings: The Untold Story tells the story of the 2018 poisoning of ex-Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia in the quiet city of Salisbury, an incident that sent shockwaves across the globe. Just months later, British mother of three Dawn Sturgess died accidentally after coming into contact with Novichok, the nerve agent used in the original attack.
title: Salisbury Poisonings: The Untold Story

overview: House of Stassi follows reality TV icon Stassi Schroeder as she steps into her next act. In this meta-docuseries, Stassi navigates her long-awaited return to television — this time with the people she loves most by her side. As her ambition pulls her back into the spotlight, those around her level up. But as cameras roll and truths surface, her closest relationships are put to the test.
title: House of Stassi
